data_description.current_entity: Wallbox current setting in amperes, not kW (for go-e, typically the entity ending in _amp).
data_description.control_on: For select/input_select control: exact option that enables charging. Spelling must match the entity.
data_description.control_off: For select/input_select control: exact option that disables charging. Must differ from the enable option.
data_description.phase_1: Exact phase-selector option for single-phase charging; required when phase switching is configured.
data_description.phase_3: Exact phase-selector option for three-phase charging; required when phase switching is configured.
data_description.power_sensor: Measured electrical power of this device in W or kW, not cumulative energy in kWh. Improves detection and allocation.
data_description.connected_entity: Optional connection sensor. Without it SEP assumes a car is connected.
data_description.soc_sensor: Optional car battery charge percentage. A valid reading is required for state-of-charge cutoff.
data_description.capacity: Usable car battery capacity in kWh, not home battery capacity.
data_description.consumption: Average car consumption in kWh per 100 km. Higher values plan more energy for the same distance.
data_description.min_current: Minimum charging current supported by the car and wallbox, usually 6 A.
data_description.max_current: Maximum charging current SEP may request, within the limits of your installation. 16 A on three phases is approximately 11 kW.
data_description.phases: Number of phases without automatic switching: 1 or 3.
data_description.voltage: Voltage per phase in V, normally 230 V in Austria. Used to convert current to power.
data_description.efficiency: Percentage of input energy reaching the car battery. For example, 90% means 9 kWh stored from 10 kWh supplied.

data.name: Name
data.ww_active_entity: Optional: Hot water active (binary sensor / input boolean)
data.ww_active_minutes: Hot water active: wait before boost

data_description.boost_entity: The actuator to start a WW cycle. Button/switch/input_boolean triggers only once; SEP never sends an OFF for one-shot WW loads. A helper input_boolean needs its own automation. A switch must return to OFF externally before another trigger is possible. Number setpoints still use active boost/reset control.
data_description.sun_angle_entity: Optional numeric sun elevation in degrees, not azimuth. For sun.sun, expose its elevation attribute through a numeric sensor. Requires a threshold and the active switch.
data_description.sun_angle_min: Optional minimum elevation. 12° allows starting at exactly 12°. Unset means ignored. Also select an entity and enable the check.
data_description.cloud_now_entity: Optional current-hour cloud forecast from 0 to 100 percent. Requires both hourly entities, both thresholds and an active cloud check.
data_description.cloud_now_max: Start requires cloud cover strictly below this value: 75% blocks at exactly 75%. Both hours must pass. Incomplete configuration ignores the entire cloud check.
data_description.cloud_next_entity: Optional next-hour cloud forecast from 0 to 100 percent. The source must keep this value relative to the next hour. SEP reads its numeric state, not a forecast attribute list.
data_description.cloud_next_max: Next-hour cloud cover must also be strictly below this limit: exactly 50% blocks a 50% limit. An unset limit ignores this check until both sources and limits are complete.
data_description.ww_active_entity: Optional binary_sensor/input_boolean: on during hot-water preparation, off otherwise. A one-shot boost is allowed after the configured wait with control budget ≥ 0 W. Unknown/unavailable signals inhibit starts. SEP only reads this entity.
data_description.ww_active_minutes: Hot water must stay continuously on for this duration before a one-shot boost is allowed with current control budget ≥ 0 W. Default 10 minutes, range 0–180 (0 disables this special permission). Temperature, optional sun-angle filter and cooldown still apply; cloud filters are ignored for this special permission; at most one boost per cycle. Applies to button/switch/input_boolean, not number setpoints.
data_description.name: Choose a distinct display name so you can identify this device easily.
data_description.boost_type: Switch/button triggers hot water once. SEP does not reset this trigger or abort the hot-water cycle. Number control raises the setpoint and later restores it.
data_description.power_sensor: Actual heat-pump electrical power in W or kW. Required to confirm idle time for normal automatic starts; an enable switch alone is not sufficient.
data_description.nominal_power: Typical electrical demand in W; for household appliances use heating power. Used for reservations and as a fallback if no measurement is available.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Current hot-water temperature in °C. Boost starts require temperature below target minus hysteresis; invalid readings block starts.
data_description.ww_boost_temp_entity: Optional number/input_number/temperature sensor, 30–75 °C, replacing the fixed boost target. Invalid selected values block new starts. Number boosts also write this target to the heat pump.
